description: Host upload request for an attachment signing field (Signing redesign phase 6, S2-5). The runner raises it through TmSigningFormRunner.OnAttachmentSelected and stores the returned url on the attachment. Security note: the file CONTENT is read by the HOST (OpenReadStream) — never inside the component — because on Blazor Server browser files stream over SignalR with tight message limits. Without the callback the picked files stay client-side metadata (the documented placeholder behaviour).
